needs_user_input.why: Observed dated quotes are not in the filings; without them CP-3 states Insufficient Information. Fair value in Note 7 is not a quote.
Peer names/figures are user input for a relative-value run.
BGS is NYSE-listed, but market cap, EV and price are not in the corpus filings as of the cutoff.
Horizon (months) and minimum cash are user choices.
Repricing step-up (bps) is a user assumption; the filings disclose call/prepayment terms only.
Recovery percentage is a user assumption.
Filings describe guarantors as all existing and certain future domestic subsidiaries; individual names are not listed in the 10-Q text used.
No agency ratings are disclosed in the filings.

limitations: Only the 2025-06-28 10-Q (filed 2025-08-04) is cited. The other four corpus filings were not used for module facts; December 28, 2024 comparatives are taken from this 10-Q.

Amounts are as printed. The checker scale enum has no 'thousands': facts printed in USD thousands carry scale null and the locator says 'amounts in USD thousands as printed'; facts printed in millions carry scale millions. Ratios (x) carry unit null.
Quotes keep zero-width spaces (U+200B) present in the filing HTML, because the normalisation does not remove them.
Revolver commitment 475.0 is the balance-sheet-date figure; the 430.0 figure took effect on 2025-07-01 (Note 18) and is recorded separately.
The credit agreement and indentures are not in the corpus; floors, financial definitions and exact guarantor names are not golden.
